messages.message: Research agents independently assess evidence. No round authorization or forecasting deposit is submitted until all four decisions validate.
Owner approves exact policy terms. All investment capital stays in the trading Safe.
Validated model allocations are submitted under the fixed owner-approved asset policy.
Independent model forecasts are compared with actual v4 entry quotes; no qualifying edge means abstain.
Anvil advances the local clock; final-window scores select the canonical winner.
Onchain selected proposal 0 with target 0 bps. No caller supplies the winning target.
The restricted module reads the winner and executes the approved allocation through the Safe.
Record actual holdings and advance the local evaluation horizon. Prices remain explicit simulation fixtures.
The tracker computes return from recorded quantities and simulated prices, including actual fixture-router fees.
Forecasters redeem only winning-world claims; Safe investment balances are not used for payouts.
Model-directed local round completed. Real Safe/v4 transactions; prices and assets remain simulated; inference attestation not verified.
